release: Stable V2 RC3 — Repository & Documentation Cleanup
policy: External runtime dependencies and AI/voice models are downloaded only when missing and only after user confirmation. They are not embedded in RaceEngineer.exe.

llm.required_for: Free local LLM explanations in post-LIVE Performance Review and optional reasoning radio requests

notes.ptt: PTT has no separate downloadable model. HID/audio/PTT runtime dependencies are covered by hidapi, sounddevice, pygame and the STT model checks above.
notes.ffmpeg: External ffmpeg is not a hard dependency for the current faster-whisper/PyAV path. The launcher logs whether it is present but does not install it.
